title: 《遗忘之海》平台入口怎么选：Steam、官网启动器、移动端、TapTap 与云游戏区别
titleEn: Sea of Remnants Platform Entry Guide: Steam, Official Launcher, and July 23 Mobile Launch
summary: 这是遗忘之海平台选择页。主下载入口请先看 /zh/sea/download；本页负责区分 Steam、官网启动器、iOS、Android、TapTap、云游戏和账号区服选择。
summaryEn: Mobile is live on July 23. This guide routes Steam, official launcher, iOS, Android, cloud trial, account/server checks, and first-day troubleshooting.
content:
## 本页定位：帮你选平台，不替代主下载页

如果你已经决定要下载，先去 [遗忘之海下载主入口](/zh/sea/download) 确认官网、Steam、TapTap、iOS、Android 和云游戏入口。本页负责回答“我该用 Steam 还是官网启动器”“手机端和 PC 怎么选”“云游戏是不是普通客户端”。

## 平台入口怎么选

《遗忘之海》现在已经从 **7 月 9 日 PC 公测**进入到 **7 月 23 日 10:00 移动端首发**阶段；移动端此前已有 **7 月 21 日 10:00 预下载**节点。今天最重要的不是再判断“手机端什么时候上”，而是按你的设备习惯选择入口，并保证账号、区服和奖励领取不要乱。

| 平台 | 适合谁 | 今日重点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Steam | 想用商店库管理和 PC 长时间玩的玩家 | 继续用 PC 推主线、探索和高负载战斗 |
| 官方启动器 | 想跟官网活动、公告、补丁走的玩家 | 更适合看更新、活动和账号说明 |
| iOS | 今天从手机端入坑的苹果玩家 | 先确认 App Store / 官方渠道入口、账号、剩余空间和画质稳定性 |
| Android | 今天从手机端入坑的安卓玩家 | 先确认官网 / TapTap / 应用商店渠道，预下载包也要检查最终更新 |
| 云试玩 / PV | 想先了解氛围的玩家 | 适合低成本确认美术、捏脸和玩法气质 |

## 今日下载前先检查

1. 账号是否和预约、PC 端或活动页面一致。
2. 区服是否要和 PC 端保持一致。
3. 手机端是否有足够空间、稳定网络和散热余量。
4. 预约礼、平台礼包、充值和邮件奖励是否已经看过公告。
5. 如果你只是被 gamescom demo 带进来，先看 gameplay / review FAQ，不要直接假设主机日期。
6. 首发福利、SSR、自选和抽数类信息先以游戏内公告为准，再决定是否领取。

## 常见问题

- 如果 Steam 页面打不开，先切换官方启动器入口。
- 如果手机端搜索不到，先确认商店地区、官方公告和 TapTap 页面。
- 如果更新慢，先确认磁盘/手机空间和网络稳定性。
- 如果今天从 PC 切手机，先确认账号和区服，不要重复开新号。
- 如果 7 月 21 日已经预下载，今天仍要检查商店更新、资源校验和足够空间。

contentEn:
## Pick the Right Entry

Sea of Remnants has moved from the **July 9 PC open beta** into the **July 23 10:00 mobile launch** window. The key question is no longer when mobile arrives. It is which entry fits your device habits and how to keep account, server, and rewards aligned.

| Platform | Best for | Today’s focus |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Steam | PC users who prefer store-library management | Continue story, exploration, and high-load combat on PC |
| Official launcher | Players who follow official events and patch notes | Best for official updates and account notices |
| iOS | Phone-first Apple users | Confirm App Store entry, account, and stable graphics first |
| Android | Phone-first Android users | Use official site / TapTap / verified stores, not unofficial packages |
| Cloud trial / PV | Players researching the atmosphere | Low-cost way to understand art style and tone |

## Check Before Downloading Today

1. Account route matches reservation, PC, or event pages.
2. Server choice stays consistent with PC progress.
3. Device has storage, stable network, and thermal headroom.
4. Reservation gifts, platform rewards, payments, and mail rewards follow official notices.
5. If you came from gamescom demo discussion, read gameplay/review FAQ before assuming console timing.

## Common Issues

- If Steam is not ideal, use the official launcher.
- If mobile search fails, check store region, official notices, and TapTap.
- If updates are slow, confirm storage and network stability.
- If switching from PC to mobile today, verify account and server before starting over.

## Next Steps

- [Mobile launch FAQ](/en/sea/guides/mobile-launch-guide)
- [Week-one live-ops hub](/en/sea/guides/week-one-live-ops-overview)
- [Known issues and hotfix tracker](/en/sea/guides/known-issues-hotfix-guide)
- [Steam / Release Date / Gacha / Solo FAQ](/en/sea/guides/steam-release-gacha-solo-faq)

faq.questionZh: 今天从哪个平台下载最稳？
faq.question: Which platform is safest to download from today?
faq.answerZh: PC 玩家优先 Steam 或官方启动器；手机玩家优先官网、TapTap、App Store 或认证应用商店。不要用第三方私包。
faq.answer: PC players should use Steam or the official launcher. Mobile players should use the official site, TapTap, App Store, or verified stores. Avoid third-party packages.

faq.questionZh: 今天从 PC 切到手机要注意什么？
faq.question: What should I check when switching from PC to mobile today?
faq.answerZh: 先确认同一账号、同一区服，再领取关键奖励。不要因为手机端首发就随手开新服。
faq.answer: Confirm the same account and server before claiming major rewards. Do not start a random new server just because mobile launched.

faq.questionZh: gamescom demo 是平台上线信息吗？
faq.question: Is the gamescom demo a platform-release confirmation?
faq.answerZh: 不是。它是全球试玩/曝光信号，适合关注 demo、review 和 gameplay，但主机或海外平台日期仍以官方商店页为准。
faq.answer: No. It is a global demo/exposure signal. Console or overseas platform timing still needs official store confirmation.
